ex.en: The doctor continued to observe the patient's behavior.
ex.zh: 醫生繼續觀察病人的一舉一動。

ex.en: The lonely man derives pleasure from observing ants.
ex.zh: 那個孤僻的人以觀察螞蟻為樂。

ex.en: The woman observes and the man thinks.
ex.zh: 女人觀察，男人思考。

ex.en: He observed that we should probably have rain coming.
ex.zh: 他說大概快下雨了。

ex.en: "It's getting late," she observed.
ex.zh: 「時間不早了。」她說。

ex.en: All drivers must observe the speed limit.
ex.zh: 所有駕駛都必須遵守速限。

ex.en: Many families still observe this tradition.
ex.zh: 許多家庭仍然遵守這個傳統。

ex.en: I am able to obtain a registration form for free.
ex.zh: 我可以免費索取報名表。

ex.en: It is necessary to obtain the sanction of the authorities to enter this building.
ex.zh: 要進入這棟大樓，必須取得有關當局的許可。

ex.en: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.
ex.zh: 他們的投資獲得了百分之八的報酬。

obligate.zh: 使負有義務（常用 be obligated to）

ex.en: I felt obligated.
ex.zh: 我覺得有義務這麼做。

ex.en: Employees are obligated to follow the safety rules.
ex.zh: 員工有義務遵守安全規定。

oblige.zh: 迫使（be obliged to 不得不、有義務）

ex.en: She was obliged to give up the plan.
ex.zh: 她不得不放棄那個計畫。

ex.en: We're not obliged to do that for Tom.
ex.zh: 我們沒有義務替湯姆做那件事。

ex.en: The train was so crowded that we were obliged to stand all the way to Osaka.
ex.zh: 火車太擠了，我們只好一路站到大阪。

oblige.zh: 幫忙、答應（請求）；（much obliged）非常感激

ex.en: I'd be happy to oblige if you need any help.
ex.zh: 如果你需要幫忙，我很樂意效勞。

ex.en: I'm much obliged to you for your help.
ex.zh: 非常感謝你的幫忙。

ex.en: Observers expect prices to fall next year.
ex.zh: 觀察人士預期明年價格會下跌。

ex.en: She attended the meeting as an observer.
ex.zh: 她以觀察員身分出席會議。

ex.en: Tom was the biggest obstacle for them.
ex.zh: 湯姆是他們最大的阻礙。

ex.en: He can overcome any obstacle.
ex.zh: 他能克服任何障礙。

ex.en: Bats use ultrasound to locate obstacles.
ex.zh: 蝙蝠利用超音波來找出障礙物的位置。

ex.en: I read his obituary in the newspaper.
ex.zh: 我在報紙上看到他的訃聞。

ex.en: The obituary described her as a kind teacher.
ex.zh: 訃聞形容她是一位親切的老師。

ex.en: The meaning of this sentence is obscure.
ex.zh: 這個句子的意思很模糊。

ex.en: The instructions were written in obscure language.
ex.zh: 說明書的用語很難懂。

ex.en: He was an obscure writer before he won the prize.
ex.zh: 他得獎前是個沒沒無聞的作家。

ex.en: The song was written by an obscure band.
ex.zh: 這首歌是一個不知名的樂團寫的。

ex.en: Clouds obscured our view of the mountain.
ex.zh: 雲遮住了我們看山的視線。

ex.en: The report obscures the real problems.
ex.zh: 這份報告掩蓋了真正的問題。

ex.en: Tom is obviously going to need more help.
ex.zh: 湯姆顯然會需要更多幫助。

ex.en: This drink's flavor is obviously that of tea.
ex.zh: 這個飲料喝起來明顯是茶的味道。

ex.en: He can speak French, and obviously English.
ex.zh: 他會說法語，英語當然也會。

ex.en: The house was full of colorful art objects.
ex.zh: 房子裡擺滿了色彩繽紛的藝術品。

ex.en: Do not leave any objects on the stairs.
ex.zh: 不要把任何物品留在樓梯上。

ex.en: His main object in life was to become rich.
ex.zh: 他人生的主要目標是成為有錢人。

ex.en: The object of the game is to score points.
ex.zh: 這個遊戲的目標是得分。

ex.en: He objects to being treated like a child.
ex.zh: 他不喜歡被當成小孩對待。

ex.en: I objected to his paying the bill.
ex.zh: 我反對讓他付帳。

ex.en: He objected to his wife working outside.
ex.zh: 他反對妻子在外工作。

ex.en: It was obvious that they had told a lie.
ex.zh: 很明顯他們說了謊。

ex.en: It's so obvious we don't need proof.
ex.zh: 事情這麼明顯，根本不需要證據。

ex.en: It seems obvious that he is sick.
ex.zh: 他顯然是生病了。

ex.en: Her acute observation skills make her a very suitable photographer.
ex.zh: 她敏銳的觀察力讓她很適合當攝影師。

ex.en: His observations are sharp, but he doesn't say much.
ex.zh: 他的觀察很敏銳，但話不多。

ex.en: The patient was kept under observation overnight.
ex.zh: 病人留院觀察了一晚。

ex.en: Let me make a few observations about the report.
ex.zh: 讓我針對這份報告提出幾點看法。

ex.en: She made an interesting observation about the market.
ex.zh: 她對市場提出了一個很有意思的見解。

ex.en: Every player is under obligation to keep the rules.
ex.zh: 每位選手都有義務遵守規則。

ex.en: I actually don't have an obligation to help you.
ex.zh: 其實我沒有義務幫你。

ex.en: It is our obligation to help.
ex.zh: 幫忙是我們的義務。

ex.en: Ghosts and gods are the obsessions of the human world.
ex.zh: 鬼神是人世間的執念。

ex.en: Her obsession with cleanliness affects her daily life.
ex.zh: 她對清潔的執著影響了她的日常生活。

ex.en: Fame has become an obsession for him.
ex.zh: 名氣已成為他念念不忘的執念。

ex.en: I have been obsessed with French recently.
ex.zh: 我最近著迷於法語。

ex.en: Carl, you're obsessed with money.
ex.zh: Carl，你被錢迷住了。

ex.en: He is obsessed with baseball.
ex.zh: 他對棒球著了迷。

obscene.zh: 猥褻的、淫穢的、令人厭惡的

ex.en: One must be respectful when speaking, and not say obscene things.
ex.zh: 開口要有禮貌，不講下流話。

ex.en: The film was banned for its obscene content.
ex.zh: 這部電影因內容猥褻而被禁演。

ex.en: He was fined for making obscene gestures at the referee.
ex.zh: 他因對裁判做出下流手勢而被罰款。

ex.en: The company replaced its obsolete billing system.
ex.zh: 公司汰換了過時的帳務系統。

ex.en: These parts are obsolete and hard to find.
ex.zh: 這些零件已經停產，很難找到。

ex.en: Rapid obsolescence makes regular upgrades necessary.
ex.zh: 快速淘汰使定期升級變得必要。

ex.en: The design reduces the risk of early obsolescence.
ex.zh: 這項設計降低了產品提早過時的風險。

ex.en: The report examines how sleep affects childhood obesity.
ex.zh: 這份報告探討睡眠如何影響兒童肥胖問題。

ex.en: The program addresses obesity through nutrition education and exercise.
ex.zh: 這項計畫透過營養教育和運動處理肥胖問題。

ex.en: In the end he achieved his objective.
ex.zh: 他終於完成了他的目標。

ex.en: He explained the plan's main objective.
ex.zh: 他解釋了這個計劃的主要目標。

ex.en: The objectives of the marketing department and the sales department are not necessarily the same.
ex.zh: 行銷部和業務部的目標不見得相同。

ex.en: It's hard to stay objective and calm when it happens to you.
ex.zh: 事情發生在自己身上時，很難保持客觀冷靜。

ex.en: Does objective history exist?
ex.zh: 客觀的歷史存在嗎？

ex.en: I have no objection to your plan.
ex.zh: 我不反對你的計劃。

ex.en: She has a strong objection to my plan.
ex.zh: 她強烈反對我的計劃。

ex.en: If Tom wants to stay, I have no objection.
ex.zh: 如果湯姆想留下來，我沒有意見。
